title: Checkout retry policy
content: Checkout retry uses exponential backoff with jitter on payment capture.

title: Payment timeout circuit breaker
content: Payment timeout uses a circuit breaker after repeated capture failures.

title: Payment timeout fallback queue
content: Payment timeout enqueues a fallback queue when the breaker opens.

title: Inventory SLA forty seconds
content: Inventory SLA is forty seconds for stock reservation.

title: Inventory SLA four minutes
content: Inventory SLA is four minutes for stock reservation.

title: Widget synchronizer handshake
content: Widget synchronizer handshake protocol uses nonce tokens.

title: Password reset email code
content: As a user I can reset my password using a one-time email code. The code is valid for 15 minutes.

title: Password reset SRS
content: The password reset email code expires 15 minutes after it is issued. Expired codes must be rejected.
